opening.text: I'm feeling tired, weak and low on energy for six months. I've lost 8 pounds during that time and have a poor appetite. Recently I've noticed more foul-smelling and greasy-looking stools, and I do feel some discomfort in my stomach. I drink beer, I take Tylenol, and I used to smoke but I quit six months ago.
